analysis:
Examined the changed files: docs/developer/test.md (documentation only), scripts/ci-component-paths.py (adds a mimo_audio CI routing component), scripts/install-release-cmake.sh (tool-cache shortcut), and scripts/test-ci-component-paths.py (tests for the new routing). These are CI and build tooling and do not touch the provider runtime, the coordinator wire contract, attestation, App Attest authorization, key custody, or prefix-cache storage. None of the threat-model assets or boundaries (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009 to TB-013) is affected.

ci-component-paths.py: the mimo_audio selection only controls whether an expensive audio-gate job runs. Every MIMO_AUDIO pattern is also a provider input, and master pushes and COMMON paths still select all components. The worst outcome of a routing gap is a skipped test, not an exposure. The new MIMO_AUDIO list includes libs/mlx*, Package.swift, ci.yml and the fixture scripts. It may miss some inputs, which is a coverage question rather than a vulnerability.

install-release-cmake.sh (head lines 15-19): the runner-tool-cache path is used when a '.complete' marker exists and the cached cmake reports version 3.31.12. The cached copy is not re-verified against the pinned SHA-256 that the download path checks (head lines 26-28); trust rests on a version string and a marker written by the Darkbloom macOS image provisioning. This weakens integrity on those runners only if the runner tool cache is attacker-writable, which the supplied evidence does not establish. The CI build toolchain feeds release provider artifacts (A-011, T-034), so the next pass should confirm that the tool cache is image-owned and immutable for jobs, and that PR workflows from untrusted forks cannot write it. This is an unverified external contract, so I raise no finding. RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE is set by the runner, and the fallback path /nonexistent is harmless.

The test.md changes cover only test documentation and CI cache policy (PRs save no build cache), a hardening of cache poisoning. The test file's only visible change is more routing assertions.
